name: damn-center-extension
description: Center any website on your widescreen or ultrawide monitor. Per-site padding, rulers, themes and patterns for Chrome, Firefox and Safari.

scripts.zip-source-code: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/damn-center-source-v$npm_package_version.zip && git ls-files | zip -q dist/damn-center-source-v$npm_package_version.zip -@
scripts.build:chrome: TARGET=chrome vite build --mode development && TARGET=chrome BUILD_TARGET=content vite build --mode development && rm -f dist/damn-center-chrome-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/chrome && zip -qr ../damn-center-chrome-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.build:firefox: TARGET=firefox vite build --mode development && TARGET=firefox BUILD_TARGET=content vite build --mode development && rm -f dist/damn-center-firefox-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/firefox && zip -qr ../damn-center-firefox-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.build:safari: TARGET=safari vite build --mode development && TARGET=safari BUILD_TARGET=content vite build --mode development && rm -f dist/damn-center-safari-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/safari && zip -qr ../damn-center-safari-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.build: tsc && pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run build:firefox && pnpm run build:safari && pnpm run zip-source-code
scripts.build:chrome:release: TARGET=chrome vite build --mode production && TARGET=chrome BUILD_TARGET=content vite build --mode production && rm -f dist/damn-center-chrome-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/chrome && zip -qr ../damn-center-chrome-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.build:firefox:release: TARGET=firefox vite build --mode production && TARGET=firefox BUILD_TARGET=content vite build --mode production && rm -f dist/damn-center-firefox-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/firefox && zip -qr ../damn-center-firefox-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.build:safari:release: TARGET=safari vite build --mode production && TARGET=safari BUILD_TARGET=content vite build --mode production && rm -f dist/damn-center-safari-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist/safari && zip -qr ../damn-center-safari-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.build:release: tsc && pnpm run build:chrome:release && pnpm run build:firefox:release && pnpm run build:safari:release && pnpm run zip-source-code
